integrity: Exact symbolic polynomial certificates are supplied in checker.py with declared dependency; numerical approximations are only illustrative. Independent verification and historical priority review have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact extremum concerns two distinct point-evaluation kernels of equal norm for the quadratic monomial in the unweighted disk Bergman space. It neither optimizes unrestricted unequal-radius pairs nor establishes optimality for other targets or weights; historical-priority risks persist.
title: Sharp equal-sensitivity two-kernel approximation of a quadratic Bergman monomial
